doc_friction.issue: Registering a new venture in the catalogue takes four hand edits (two build.mjs group regexes with comments, launched.json, the SWITCHES_IN_THE_CATALOGUE count in optout-persistence.test.mjs), and no doc lists them; I found them by grepping the previous explore venture's slug. A one-line pointer or a scaffold script would save each new-venture run that grep.

pages.yml's two _site checks report FAIL when its build step is skipped (a ${{ }} expression). They should report UNRUN, as budget-cut steps now do, so a run does not have to look into an expected failure.

deviations.why: 'Calculators are a poor use of a run.' I built a calculator-shaped tool anyway, because a monthly accumulate-and-dry simulation with a taut-string vapour profile and a bisection for safe RH is not something a chatbot reply does reliably, and it graduates an existing research model into a product.
deviations.did: Built it as an engine plus a worked guide, and recorded the reasoning in VENTURE.yaml
deviations.result: Merged with 25 tests; whether people use it is unmeasured

notes: Explore idea: graduate research/house-dewpoint (a fixed four-climate Glaser table in Python) into a browser venture, wall-condensation-check, that takes any layers and any monthly climate. Engine: ISO 13788 psat over water and ice, a taut-string vapour profile by gift wrapping over the interfaces, condensed water carried forward with wet interfaces pinned at saturation (so they dry), the ISO start month, two-year runs to expose accumulation, and the safe indoor RH by bisection. duplicate_check top match 0.11. Verification: node --test 25/25 (hand-checked two-layer rate, moisture conservation, poly/XPS behaviour, unit equivalence F/C); optout-persistence 20/20; tools.mjs call works; Chromium at 390/1100 px has no errors and no horizontal scroll. No agent doc: the README and VENTURE.yaml carry what the next run needs. Next: reproduce an ISO 13788 annex example, humidity-dependent permeance, an air-leakage term. Local CI (run_workflow_locally --for-changes): everything green except (a) sibling-links, fixed in this PR; (b) agent-permission-harness byte-identity, which was racing my new run-record file (14331 vs 14332 files) and passes on a rerun; (c) the distribution hub tests, which failed once during the parallel run and pass 50/50 when rerun on the branch; (d) the pages.yml _site checks, which the local runner skips because the build step uses a ${{ }} expression, so I built the site and ran them separately.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
